materials.item: Storage bins for bags and loose items
Fire extinguisher signage and mounting hardware
materials.note: relocate stool and sign to make extinguisher visible

workOrder.title: Clear egress path and store bags
workOrder.detail: Remove patterned bag and other bags from floor near exit door and fire extinguisher; place in storage closet or bins away from egress path to keep exit clear.

workOrder.title: Secure and cover stage cables
workOrder.detail: Gather loose black cables on stage, route along walls, bundle with zip ties and cover walkway crossings with cable covers and gaffer tape to eliminate trip hazard.

workOrder.title: Make fire extinguisher accessible
workOrder.detail: Move stool and yellow Hope City sign away from wall, ensure extinguisher is fully visible, mounted at proper height, and signed; verify second extinguisher is also clear.

workOrder.title: Mark stage edge and steps
workOrder.detail: Apply high-visibility edge tape or paint to front edge of stage platform and nosing to steps to warn of drop-off.

workOrder.title: Clean and refinish stage floor
workOrder.detail: Sweep and mop stage floor to remove debris and scuffs, then touch up black paint where worn. Do after cables are secured to avoid painting over cords.

workOrder.title: Organize and secure stage equipment
workOrder.detail: Return speaker, mic stands, guitar stand, chairs and keyboards to designated storage or marked positions; coil and label cords, store cases off walkways.

costRange.label: Rough estimate, not a quote
assumptions: Region is Sebring, FL and nearby Highlands County retail at home-improvement stores serving Sebring.
Prices are mid-grade materials bought retail before sales tax.
Labor basis is volunteer: volunteer trade steps are unpaid at zero cost and only the painter step is paid.
One cable-cover kit means one 5-ft over-floor channel; gaffer tape is one 2-inch by 30-yard roll; zip ties means one pack of ties or Velcro straps.

Storage bin means one 19 to 27 gallon latching tote; signage set means one wall sign plus screws and anchors; edge tape is one roll; stair nosing is one adhesive set for one to two steps; cleaner is one 1-gallon bottle; paint is one gallon of porch and floor enamel; rack means one freestanding metal storage rack.

Grounded prices are cable cover kit, fire extinguisher sign, heavy-duty floor cleaner, black floor paint, and Sebring painter wage; gaffer tape, zip ties, storage bins, stage edge tape, stair nosing, and equipment rack are not grounded and use wide estimate ranges.
Total = materials + labor + contingency, computed from the line items
